datasets.contents: Configuration profiles labeled measured, with load-dependent values and calibration summaries
datasets.record_scope: Configuration-level calibration summaries, load-dependent values and source identifiers (paths and digests).

datasets.contents: Figure 1 run means and coefficients, Figure 2 nominal calibration and Batched MIG acquisition plan
datasets.record_scope: Figure 1 inputs are run summaries. The Figure 2 nominal profile reproduces the 160 ms deadline crossings. The supplied Batched MIG plan documents the intended configuration and repetition design. The original concurrent-run telemetry and archived Residency calibration support a separate check.

datasets.contents: Figure 2(b) simulation parameters, archived statistics, regenerated window means and request counts, and source provenance
datasets.record_scope: The archived JSON includes the first 24 window means per rate. The NPZ contains 1,024 regenerated window means and request counts per rate for nine rates, using a 10 s warm-up, a 45 s observation window and seed 2026102517. The audit verifies the saved evidence numerically. The optional CPU replay compares all saved windows and counts.

datasets.contents: Simulated window-response means, request counts, per-row seeds and parameters, nested sample prefixes, and the row-wise P95/P99 quantiles used by the admission planner
datasets.processing: The 256/512-window arrays are exact prefixes of each 1024-window simulation row. P95/P99 use linear quantile interpolation. Audits check all 7,938 quantiles, source checksums, seeds, parameters and configuration/rate mappings. The simulation protocol is recorded in admission_grid_samples.json.

datasets.contents: Archived response errors, Figure 4 response pairs, and author-supplied power comparisons for Table 6.
datasets.record_scope: Paired MIG and Full GPU use archived response errors. Batched MIG uses the 69 analytical predictions and observed responses from Figure 4. All four power groups use the CSV of 166 pairs. The Paired MIG power cohort excludes one throttled run.

datasets.contents: Predicted objective pairs and measured comparison records for Table 7
datasets.record_scope: The measured rows use completed utility and energy through drain for two repetitions per workload. The two measured occupancy rows use the 15 November 2026 acquisition and the archived October 2026 Greedy-C reference. The release archive includes the failed lane and its recovery.

datasets.contents: Publication table statistics used as comparison targets
datasets.record_scope: Printed numerical targets for the table builders.
Panel (a) covers 45 s and 900 s windows. Panel (b) uses linear P95 across the supplied window means. The checks cover the window metadata and agreement with the numerical reference.

datasets.contents: 969 logical admission blocks from one acquisition campaign, modeled objective comparisons, shared preprocessing time and Figure 7 summaries
datasets.record_scope: Window means and request counts cover all feasible deployments. The denominator includes all offered requests. Objective losses and elapsed preprocessing time use separate archived records.

datasets.contents: Figure 7 acquisition archive in ordered parts, with a manifest for byte-for-byte restoration
datasets.record_scope: The 969 logical blocks correspond to 797 distinct physical runs and 172 aliases. The archive contains request timestamps, NVML GPU samples, completion certificates and inventories for both acquisition lanes. The default numerical audit continues to use the compact Figure 7 inputs.

datasets.contents: Per-case plans, objective values and timing records for the 112 supplied workloads.
datasets.record_scope: Timing scopes are described in results/planning/README.md.

datasets.contents: Supplied occupancy-policy outcomes and paired predicted objectives
datasets.record_scope: The 112 seed-0 outcomes and the frozen ranking and grid reproduce Figure 6 and the predicted occupancy columns of Table 7.

datasets.contents: Four method exports in results/scaling/source/, 160 publication observations, descriptive statistics and 40 frozen batch-1 workload inputs.
datasets.record_scope: Each export contains planning timings, objectives and selected plans. The scaling audit checks the export SHA-256 and matches the per-case service counts, planning times, ratios and losses against the publication records.

datasets.contents: Reference PDFs for the eight figure entry points
datasets.record_scope: Figure 2 is exported from its supplied PDF; the other figure entry points render from distributed inputs.

scope: Inventory of distributed datasets, record fields and processing. Checks validate file identity and arithmetic consistency.
